overall.verdict: Mobile dark has a real total, mint settled states, and the Hub One notch bar is the one shipping-quality idea—but 1px=$50 is explained in Settings and violated on Home, Pay, Receive, and Swap, so visceral value never lands. Card stacks, repeated legends, clipped chips, and two different receipts keep it below a calm fintech bar.
priority_fixes: Enforce one absolute bar scale (Settings 1px=$50) on Home total, USDC row, Hub One send/receive, Pay delta, and Activity amounts; fade overflow instead of rescaling.
Delete duplicate composition: Home legend + Instant line + per-row send/receive captions + Account 50k table—one notch bar and one net number per surface.
Unify Frame #40 receipt (post-pay sheet and Activity detail): same proof, same layout, peek the Hub One bar so the $25 move is visible.
Equal-weight Pay/Receive/Swap on Home; reserve filled indigo for the in-flow confirm button only.
Fix mobile overflow: Activity “Accounts” chip, Swap network control, Receive clipped QR, Settings $50 chip, Account copy under the tab bar.
